english.note: Use this when stressing that someone knows what to say or do without going too far.
Use this for tactful, considerate behaviour that avoids offending or overstepping.

examples.english: You are really tactful; when Auntie did not want to answer, you did not ask again.
examples.traditional: 你講嘢真係好有分寸，阿姨唔想答就唔再問。
examples.jyutping: nei5 gong2 je5 zan1 hai6 hou2 jau5 fan1 cyun3 aa3 ji1 m4 soeng2 daap3 zau6 m4 zoi3 man6

examples.english: You need to be delicate when discussing other people's private matters; don't push your questions too far.
examples.traditional: 講人哋私事要有分寸，唔好問得太盡。
examples.jyutping: gong2 jan4 dei6 si1 si6 jiu3 jau5 fan1 cyun3 m4 hou2 man6 dak1 taai3 zeon6
